title: DEPHYRIER Bhej Dena (Shift Enter Discipline)
style: format-discipline anthem, 92 bpm, English Hindi romanization French trilingual, deadpan slack-formatting recital, terminal core, shift-enter chant, DEPHYRIER signature, no-double-bullet groove, message-draft flow
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Shift Enter line break Enter sends the message
Draft the entire post then commit at the threshold
Asterisk for bold underscore italic tilde strike
Slack markdown the syntax that you must like

[Pre-Chorus — Hindi romanization]
Shift Enter naya panktti Enter bhej
DEPHYRIER ka niyam saraal sej
(Shift Enter new line Enter send / DEPHYRIER's rule simple bed)

[Chorus — trilingual]
Shift Enter Maj Entrée bhej dena
The message draft control the kena
Never press Enter while still drafting
The formatting checklist before sending

[Verse 2 — English]
Cmd shift eight for bullets then tab indent
Never manually type the bullet meant
Before screenshot verify formatting clean
No double bullets no stray asterisk seen

[Bridge — Hindi romanization]
Bullet ko haath se mat likhna
Shortcut chala ke saaf likhna
(Don't write bullets by hand / Run the shortcut write clean)

[Outro — trilingual]
Shift Enter Maj Entrée bhej dena
The message holds the format the antenna
